title: 5-5 ADA (31st ADA BDE) C-RAM Live Fire Exercise
description: 31st Air Defense Artillery Brigade executed a live fire exercise with the Land Based Phalanx Weapons System (formerly known as C-RAM) for the first time in over a decade on Fort Bliss, TX, August 19, 2025. Annual gunnery tables are conducted to ensure that air defense artillery soldiers maintain their proficiency in counter indirect fire and counter unmanned aerial systems to protect defended assets.
unit_name: 32nd Army Air and Missile Defense Command
